column1: This toolkit is not active anymore. Our new toolkit is here: https://bellingcat.gitbook.io/toolkit
Welcome to Bellingcat’s freely available online open source investigation toolkit.
This toolkit includes satellite and mapping services, tools for verifying photos and videos, websites to archive web pages, and much more.
Follow Bellingcat's work via the website or through social media. We provide workshops to familiarize with these tools, and learn open source investigative methods.

We are currently in the process of updating this toolkit. If you have any feedback on the toolkit, please get in touch with Johanna Wild (toolkit@bellingcat.com, please do not use this e-mail address to suggest tools that you would like to see added to the toolkit!)
